name: Kneeling Side Plank

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: McGill Spine Big Three Core Stabilization

steps: Lie on your side with your elbow directly beneath your shoulder and your knees bent back at 90 degrees.
Align your shoulders, hips, and knees in one straight diagonal line.
Engage your bottom oblique and hip muscles to raise your hips off the mat, supporting your weight on your forearm and knees.
Hold this position steady while keeping your chest open and neck in a neutral position.
Breathe steadily for the target duration, then gently lower your hips and switch sides.
coaching_cues: Do not allow your top hip or shoulder to roll forward toward the floor.
Press through your bottom elbow to keep your neck long and avoid sagging into your shoulder joint.
Maintain a straight line from your knees through your hips to your crown.

sources.attribution: Dr. Stuart McGill Big 3 Stabilization Protocol
